Metano launches with $12M to help enterprises secure AI agents. Artificial intelligence agent security startup Metano Inc. today launched with $12 million in funding to help enterprises secure AI agents across endpoints, cloud infrastructure and software-as-a-service applications. NYC Startups Raised $5.69B in Q3 2026. It Took 40% Fewer Deals to Do It.. New York startups raised $5.69 billion in Q3 2026, 7% more than a year ago, on 40% fewer deals.
